subject.title: feat(agents): add scoped command prompt projection

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this inventory as a public plugin API and model-prompt surface, and may host CLI guidance appear by default when `exec` is available?
rationale: The patch creates permanent external plugin descriptor fields and changes default agent instructions; code review can identify defects but cannot choose that product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Caller-scoped projection
options.body: Approve only explicit trusted-caller projection and leave existing default agent prompts unchanged.

options.title: Default host guidance
options.body: Approve global host CLI guidance for eligible agents and document the prompt, compatibility, and security contract.

options.title: Pause this consumer
options.body: Defer the prompt projection until the command inventory foundation and live-node visibility direction are accepted.

recommendation.title: Caller-scoped projection
recommendation.body: Approve only explicit trusted-caller projection and leave existing default agent prompts unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across the prompt, plugin API, and node-policy surfaces defining this product boundary.
